summary: Client only. The game's HUD messages and elements, screen effects and tutorial hints on this player's screen. With no HUD, such as in the main menu or during a level load, message calls show nothing and return false.

inConversation.summary: Whether the player is in one of the game's own conversations, not a server Dialogue.
inConversation.exampleLua:
-- client
local Hud = kcds.ui.Hud

if not Hud.inConversation() then
  Hud.showNotification("The bell rings.")
end

showNotification.summary: Shows a line in the game's notification log.
showNotification.example:
// client
kcds.ui.Hud.showNotification('The gates close at dusk.');
showNotification.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.ui.Hud.showNotification("The gates close at dusk.")
showNotification.exampleCs:
// client
Hud.ShowNotification("The gates close at dusk.");

showBanner.summary: Shows the game's info text mid-screen.

params.eventId: The game's reputation event id, a whole number.

notifyReputation.exampleCs:
// client
Hud.NotifyReputation(reputationEventId, "The guards trust you more.");

params.type: The game's result type, a whole number.
params.name: The event's name.

notifyEventResult.example:
// client
kcds.ui.Hud.notifyEventResult(resultType, 'You drove the bandits off', 'Ambush on the road');
notifyEventResult.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.ui.Hud.notifyEventResult(resultType, "You drove the bandits off", "Ambush on the road")
notifyEventResult.exampleCs:
// client
Hud.NotifyEventResult(resultType, "You drove the bandits off", "Ambush on the road");

notifyXp.summary: Shows the game's XP bar for a stat or skill.

params.type: Optional: the bar type, by default chosen from the stat.

showTutorial.summary: Shows one of the game's tutorials by name.

params.name: The tutorial's name in the game's table.

hideTutorial.summary: Hides one of the game's tutorials.

setHudPart.summary: Hides or shows a HUD element while your resource runs: Compass, Stats, QAMWeapon, QAMFood, Subtitles, InfoText, GameLog, Hints, DialogLeft, DialogRight, Cursor, Crime, Wanted, PopUpBackground, TutorialMessage, FancyEvent, SkillCheck, ItemTransfer, Buffs, CommonEvent, DiceCursor, Trespassing, RatioStrips, ShootingContest, Bubbles, TutorialInDialog, DiceContainer or Vignette. An element stays hidden while any resource hides it.

hudPartShown.summary: Whether no resource is hiding an element.
hudPartShown.exampleLua:
-- client
if not kcds.ui.Hud.hudPartShown("Compass") then
  print("a resource hides the compass")
end

setInnerVoice.summary: Lets the player's character speak the game's remarks, which are off by default on KCDS: their comments to the horse and on screens, and their comments on their own state (tired, hungry, wet), which the game starts as a dialog of the player alone.

innerVoiceOn.summary: Whether the character's remarks are on. False by default.

setCutscenes.summary: Lets quests' story cutscenes play on this player's screen for the session. By default on KCDS, each is skipped, the quest continues as if it had played, and storyCutsceneSuppressed fires. Fast travel, sleeping and waiting always play. A skipped cutscene does not play later.

cutscenesOn.summary: Whether story cutscenes play. False by default.

effectList.summary: The screen effects with their parameters, ranges and defaults: colorGrade (saturation, brightness, contrast, cyan, magenta, yellow, darkness, hue), and blur, ghosting and screenBlood (amount).
effectList.exampleLua:
-- client
for _, effect in ipairs(kcds.ui.Hud.effectList()) do
  local names = {}
  for _, param in ipairs(effect.params) do
    table.insert(names, param.name)
  end
  print(effect.name, table.concat(names, ", "))
end

startEffect.summary: Adds a full-screen effect over this player's picture and returns its handle. Effects combine: brightness, contrast and saturation multiply, casts and hue add, and blur, ghosting and blood take the strongest. They end when your resource stops or the level changes.

params.options: Optional: `fadeInMs`, `fadeOutMs` and `durationMs`, where 0 lasts until removed.

startEffect.exampleLua:
-- client
local hurtEffect = kcds.ui.Hud.startEffect("screenBlood", { amount = 0.6 }, { fadeInMs = 200, durationMs = 1500, fadeOutMs = 800 })
startEffect.exampleCs:
// client
var hurtEffect = Hud.StartEffect("screenBlood", new { amount = 0.6 }, new { fadeInMs = 200, durationMs = 1500, fadeOutMs = 800 });

changeEffect.exampleLua:
-- client
local Hud = kcds.ui.Hud

local blurEffect = Hud.startEffect("blur", { amount = 0.2 })
Hud.changeEffect(blurEffect, { amount = 0.6 }, { fadeMs = 2000 })

endAllEffects.summary: Removes all effects your resource added.

effectRunning.summary: Whether an effect is still on.
effectRunning.exampleLua:
-- client
if not kcds.ui.Hud.effectRunning(blurEffect) then
  print("the blur is gone")
end

worldToScreen.summary: A world point's place on the screen in pixels, as { x, y, onScreen }. Null before the camera is known, which the first call starts, or for a point behind the camera.
worldToScreen.exampleLua:
-- client
local place = kcds.ui.Hud.worldToScreen(kcds.math.Vector3.new(1652.5, 2151.5, 39))
if (place and place.onScreen) then
  print("at " .. tostring(place.x) .. ", " .. tostring(place.y) .. " px")
end

showTutorialHint.summary: Shows the game's tutorial box at the top left with your content, and returns its id. $action; tokens in the text are drawn as the key bound to that action.

params.options: `text`, required; `title`; `closeHint`, default true; `durationMs`, where 0 stays until hidden.

showTutorialHint.exampleLua:
-- client
local fishingHint = kcds.ui.Hud.showTutorialHint({ title = "Fishing", text = "Stand at the water and cast.", durationMs = 10000 })
showTutorialHint.exampleCs:
// client
var fishingHint = Hud.ShowTutorialHint(new { title = "Fishing", text = "Stand at the water and cast.", durationMs = 10000 });

isTutorialHintShown.summary: Whether a hint is showing, or any of yours if no id is given.
isTutorialHintShown.exampleLua:
-- client
local Hud = kcds.ui.Hud

if not Hud.isTutorialHintShown() then
  Hud.showTutorialHint({ title = "Fishing", text = "Stand at the water and cast." })
end

isHorseCompare.summary: Whether the horse inspect screen shows the player's horse beside the one looked at. On by default, and again each session.

setHorseCompare.summary: Sets whether the horse inspect screen shows the player's horse beside the one looked at.

showShootingContest.summary: Shows the game's shooting contest table bottom left, as at the vanilla archery contests: the names and the arrows left of the player and of up to two opponents, and the target picture where hits show (showShootingHit). It stays until hideShootingContest. Throws a TypeError for a table that is not an object, a name that is not a string, a count that is not a number or more than two opponents.

params.table: { player: { name, arrows }, opponents?: [{ name, arrows }] (at most 2; a seat left out shows nobody), targetVisible?: boolean (default true) }. Arrows default to 0.

showShootingContest.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.ui.Hud.showShootingContest({ player = { name = "Henry", arrows = 5 }, opponents = { { name = "Jindra", arrows = 5 } } })
showShootingContest.exampleCs:
// client
Hud.ShowShootingContest(new { player = new { name = "Henry", arrows = 5 }, opponents = new object[] { new { name = "Jindra", arrows = 5 } } });

updateShootingContest.summary: Updates the shooting contest table: each one's arrows left and points. Throws a TypeError for the same mistakes as showShootingContest.

params.table: { player: { arrows, points }, opponents?: [{ arrows, points }] } in the order showShootingContest gave them. Left-out numbers are 0.

updateShootingContest.exampleLua:
-- client: the server sends each shot's score with player.emit('archery:score', score)
kcds.core.Events.on("archery:score", function(score)
  kcds.ui.Hud.updateShootingContest({ player = { arrows = score.arrows, points = score.points }, opponents = { { arrows = score.rivalArrows, points = score.rivalPoints } } })
end)

showShootingHit.summary: Marks where an arrow struck on the shooting contest table's target picture. Throws a TypeError for a value that is not a number and a RangeError for one outside -1 to 1.

showHorseContest.summary: Shows the game's horse race table: the player's and one opponent's name and score, and the track's name. Throws a TypeError for a table that is not an object, a name or track that is not a string or a score that is not a number.

params.table: { player: { name, score }, opponent?: { name, score }, track?: string }. Scores default to 0.

showHorseContest.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.ui.Hud.showHorseContest({ player = { name = "Henry", score = 0 }, opponent = { name = "Mutt", score = 0 }, track = "Kuttenberg meadow" })
showHorseContest.exampleCs:
// client
Hud.ShowHorseContest(new { player = new { name = "Henry", score = 0 }, opponent = new { name = "Mutt", score = 0 }, track = "Kuttenberg meadow" });

updateHorseContest.summary: Updates the player's score on the horse race table. Throws a TypeError for a score that is not a number.
